results.name: accessible names follow the accname step order: aria-labelledby (incl. hidden targets and self-reference) > aria-label > native label/alt/caption > content > title; placeholder only as the last native fallback
roles: explicit first valid token, presentation ignored on focusable elements, HTML-AAM implicit mapping incl. scoping of header/footer and named sections
spoken output: name, role words, states, value, position, description — in that order
live regions: nearest explicit aria-live wins; alert is assertive and atomic, status polite and atomic, log polite; busy suppresses; timer is off
context on focus moves: entering a dialog and a named form announces both (outermost first); moving within announces nothing; unnamed groups are skipped
reading order: landmarks announced on arrival, atomic items read whole, text runs under their element, hidden skipped; jumps by heading / landmark / field / link without wrapping
commands: unique Narrator-key chords; the toggle chord conflicts with no shell binding in any preset and is not browser-reserved; Caps Lock / Insert are used by no shell chord; speed steps clamp
